description: A6 Permissions: three requests are refused with a typed reason and an excluded person's data is served to nobody, read from the host's own captures (python3 -m scripts.access_control_proof; offline, no client, no live reader, nothing written to the host's state). Every active user of the Portal access snapshot (plx-portal-access-snapshot/v1, the in-repo role model) of the employee policy's tenant is a reader (at most 60); each asks, through CaseRuntime.resolve_citation, the item gate and the claim gate's row reader, for up to 10 stored records of each kind: another person's captured mail (mail_other), Teams content of a conversation they are not a member of (teams_other), a finance-only SharePoint file without finance clearance (finance_non_finance), any record of an excluded person (excluded_person), and mail whose sender the check cannot resolve to an object id offline (no captured mailbox records the address) in a tenant domain, or that is no address (sender_unresolved: it may be an excluded colleague's, so it is served to nobody; senders_unresolved counts them). Pass = at least one request of each of the three kinds, every request refused with a typed reason (untyped 0; a code shaped like an object id is untyped), denied_leaks 0 across every consumer and excluded_held 0 (no stored record of a person in PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS / PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_FILE). Readers the check's own oracle admits are controls (controls_served shows the guards are not refusing everything). Blocked with a typed blocked_reason while the host has no config, state, exclusion list or Portal snapshot (portal_role_tables_unshared, cause later_ask) or a capture holds no request of a kind (<kind>_requests_absent). Counts and reason codes only; no object id, e-mail, handle or tenant id is in the output.
notes: Registered, live-unverified: no host run has produced this output; it reads blocked (later_ask portal-role-tables: the Portal role tables are not served by the read-only reporting API, docs/reference/permissions.md blocker 3, so a host needs a portal_access snapshot file) until the host config names a Portal access snapshot, an employee policy and a live audience, and the captures hold each request kind. Module tests: isolated-fixture and injected-transport (tests/test_access_control_proof.py captures mail, Teams and SharePoint through the GET-only client over fake Graph transports into a temporary state directory and checks the printed summary with live_verify.check_expectations). The finance kind needs the host's Entra directory (department) to clear a finance reader; without it every reader is refused and no control is served.
